semantics: The original client's axios catch (bundle Te) renders `response.data.message` verbatim as a flash toast and falls back to 'An unexpected error occurred' ONLY when `message` is missing. It also reacts to data.captcha and data.emailVerificationRequired, and redirects on HTTP 429. Every player-facing error payload MUST therefore include a human-readable `message` field; `error` is kept alongside for server tooling.
